# Bundled runtime snapshot

Original source files are verified by SOURCE_MANIFEST.json. The original Python code, assets metadata, README, requirements and licenses are preserved. Figures, results and tests are omitted. Training meshes and CSV motion data must be downloaded separately with the included upstream tools.

Launch the native G1/JAX trainer via supermimic_lg.scripts.xmimic_native or train.py in a separate JAX environment. The PyTorch LgDog adaptation is implemented in supermimic_lg/xmimic_lg and is documented in docs/XMIMIC.md; it is not the upstream JAX implementation.
